chapter_title_en: A Banquet of Beasts and Rivals
chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning's Grand Entrance: Politics and Prestige in the Grand Xia Capital
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning, backed by Prince Yan's Golden Armored Guards, steps into the high society of the capital for a tense banquet with the elite of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly. Jealousy and power dynamics simmer beneath the surface.
og_title: The Power of a Golden Guard: Ji Ning Joins the Elite
og_description: A banquet of the Four Young Masters and the top geniuses. With a squad of elite guards at his back, Ji Ning must navigate a web of jealousy, respect, and political maneuvering as the Immortal Fortunes Assembly draws near.
twitter_title: Decoding the power politics of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
twitter_description: Ji Ning, guarded by Prince Yan's elite, steps into a vip-only banquet with jealous rivals and new allies.

lore_anchors.definition: Elite imperial bodyguards granted by the Grand Xia Emperor or a Prince as a mark of high favor, signifying the beneficiary's significant political backing.
The ultimate essence of natural energy, so pure it can be absorbed instantly without burdening the body; used as high-value currency among cultivators.
The fourth major realm of Ki Refining, meaning 'Myriad Manifestations', where a cultivator's internal Violet Palace develops stars, moon, and sun, drastically accelerating energy absorption.
The fifth major realm of Ki Refining, where a cultivator's soul undergoes a qualitative transformation, forming a 'Primal' spirit that can leave the body independently.
A title for the four most prominent and powerful young heirs from top noble clans of the Grand Xia capital; a measure of societal prestige and political influence.
A magnificent entertainment and commercial complex owned by the Zhuanshui clan, built atop Nine Suns Lake in the Grand Xia capital, known for its opulence and high-class gatherings.
